svg.text: ROUND 349 · MUSIC & ENTERTAINMENT ROYALTY ACCOUNTING (VISTEX / CISAC CWR / MLC), CONTENT ID & SYNC ESCROW
Music & Entertainment Royalty Accounting (Vistex/CWR), Content ID & Sync AI Agent Security FAQ
Artist Unrecouped Advance & Catalog M&A Valuation Air-Gap + ISWC/ISRC Split & Recoupment Lock vs. Counterclaim Injection & LOD Wire Fraud (BRK-707 / BRK-708)
🚨 1. Top 3 Music Royalty & Rights Management Threat Vectors
① Content ID / CWR Claim Injection Leaking Valuations (BRK-707)
• Adversarial rights troll CWR registration or Content ID / DSP
counter-notification PDF embeds indirect prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading superstar unrecouped advance
balances, catalog M&A multiples & unreleased master stems
② ISWC/ISRC Split Hijacking & Advance Write-Off (BRK-707)
• Reallocates 100% of publishing/master royalty splits on hit
tracks to a shell distributor & releases held Content ID escrow
• Writes off millions in unrecouped artist advances prematurely
• Impact: Streaming royalty pool theft & unrecovered advance loss
③ Spoofed Letter of Direction (LOD) & Sync Wire Fraud (BRK-708)
• Forged songwriter Letter of Direction (LOD) or film/TV Sync
licensing invoice overwrites payee IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,080 catalog advance wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Royalty trust misappropriation & co-publisher litigation
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Music & Media Royalty Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: CWR / DDEX DSR / Counterclaim Sanitization
• Strips free-text dispute narratives; extracts typed DDEX/CWR
slots (ISRC, ISWC, IPI/CAE number, territory code, claimed %)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Catalog M&A Valuation & Master Stem Air-Gap
• Catalog acquisition DCF models, superstar advance ledgers &
unreleased studio master stems isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic 100% Split Conservation & Suspense Lock
• Overlapping claims ($\sum \text{Split}_i > 100\%$) route disputed share
into Suspense Escrow; AI cannot overwrite splits or advances
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% split/recoupment tamper block)
Gate 4: Read-Only IPI Payee Registry & Notarized LOD Sign-Off
• Locks songwriter/publisher IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Music & Entertainment Royalty Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + Catalog Air-Gap + Split Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-707/708 | Music Modernization Act & SOX ready
B. Native SAP Vistex / Curve / Counterpoint RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared CWR conflict bot is hijacked via counterclaim
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to ISRC/ISWC 100% split conservation & cross-recoupment
D. Manual Royalty Administration of Billion-Row DDEX Feeds
✕ 60-90 day quarterly lag; massive "Black Box" unclaimed leakage
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 349):
• Baseline Policy: Allows split hijack, valuation leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks catalog M&A & advance read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks ISWC split hijack & write-off (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks catalog valuation egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks LOD trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,080 royalty advance wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 349)
✅ 1. Catalog Valuation & Stem Air-Gap: Isolate catalog M&A DCF models, cross-collateralized advance ledgers & unreleased stems in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic 100% Split Conservation: Route overlapping CWR/Content ID claims into Suspense Escrow; block untrusted-write on splits
✅ 3. Notarized LOD FIDO2 & Read-Only IPI Registry: Require Business Affairs + Royalty VP FIDO2 sign-off for LOD changes; lock trust-registry
📊 Cumulative Metrics: 726 Scenarios (723 Risk + 3 Benign) | 782 Pytest Checks | 1,518 Assertions | 712 Vectors | 349 Bilingual FAQs (167 SA Guides) | BRK-707/708
